tables.title: Relative Pronouns (ضمائر الوصل)
rows: Mariam was a teacher who wanted to motivate her students.
The parents whom we interviewed were all involved.
She would give a gift, which was a new pair of shoes.
The student whose marks are excellent will get the gift.
I don't like the table that stands in my kitchen.
Grandma remembers the time when radio shows were popular.
Nada came forward where the shoes were.
tables.explanation: who: للشخص الذي يقوم بالفعل (فاعل). whom: للشخص الذي يقع عليه الفعل (مفعول به). which: للشيء أو الحيوان. whose: للملكية. that: للشخص أو الشيء أو الحيوان (بديل عن who/which). when: للزمن. where: للمكان.
tables.examples:
Mariam was a teacher who wanted to motivate her students.
She would give a gift, which was a new pair of shoes.
The gift was for the student whose marks are excellent.
Nada came forward where the shoes were.

tables.title: Relative Clauses (جمل الوصل)
rows: توضح أي شخص أو شيء نقصد
The student who got the award was happy.
My father, who is 55, is a teacher.
tables.explanation: Defining: تحدد أي شخص أو شيء نقصد. لا نضع فواصل. Non-defining: تضيف معلومات إضافية. توضع بين فاصلتين.
tables.examples:
The student who got the award was happy.
My father, who is 55 years old, is a teacher.

tables.title: Word Formation (تكوين الكلمات)
tables.explanation: اختيار الكلمة المناسبة يعتمد على موقعها في الجملة: بعد الفعل (be) نستخدم صفة. بعد الفعل العادي نستخدم حال. بعد (extreme) نستخدم اسماً.
tables.examples:
Her parents couldn't afford to buy her new shoes because of their extreme poverty.
The plan is designed to motivate workers to work efficiently.
A responsible citizen respects the principles of the country.

tables.title: Past Simple Tense (الماضي البسيط)
rows: The doctor spent a week treating her.
She didn't spend all her money.
tables.explanation: نستخدم الماضي البسيط للأحداث المكتملة في الماضي. الكلمات الدالة: yesterday, last week, ago, in 2020.
tables.examples:
Last week I met Mrs. Smith.
The doctor spent a week treating her until she was finally cured.

tables.title: Gerund - love + verb-ing
tables.explanation: بعد أفعال مثل (love, like, hate, enjoy) نستخدم الفعل + ing.
tables.examples: She loves reading so she spends her free time in the school library.

tables.title: Object Pronouns (ضمائر المفعول به)
tables.explanation: ضمائر المفعول به تأتي بعد الفعل أو حرف الجر.
tables.examples: Leila gave me a beautiful souvenir.

tables.title: Present Simple Tense (المضارع البسيط)
rows: My teacher lives in the city.
tables.explanation: نستخدم المضارع البسيط للحقائق والعادات الثابتة. الكلمات الدالة: always, usually, often, sometimes, every day.
tables.examples: I want to visit the island where my teacher lives.

tables.title: Phrasal Verbs (الأفعال المركبة)
rows: She looks for ways to help her community.
He took care of his family.
tables.explanation: الأفعال المركبة هي فعل + حرف جر ويكون لها معنى خاص.
tables.examples:
She looks for ways to make her community a better place.
Before his death, he had a strong will of taking care of Suzan.

tables.title: Prepositions - because / because of
rows: She was happy because she won the prize.
She was happy because of winning the prize.
tables.explanation: because: تتبعها جملة كاملة (فاعل + فعل). because of: يتبعها اسم أو ضمير.
tables.examples: Her parents couldn't afford to buy her new shoes because of their extreme poverty.

tables.title: Possessive Pronouns (ضمائر الملكية)
tables.explanation: صفات الملكية تأتي قبل الاسم (his book). ضمائر الملكية تحل محل الاسم (This book is mine).
tables.examples: The boy spent his days delivering letters.
